title: drupilot PHP versions (config/php/versions.json)
description: The lifecycle and the tooling ids of each PHP minor drupilot reasons about (hand-maintained from php.net; refresh-data.sh does not touch it). drupal_core_floor is the oldest Drupal core minor that supports the version, when drupal.org's PHP requirements table makes it certain (every older minor is No); php_supported_for in scripts/lib/plan.sh falls back to it for a minor the table does not list.

released.description: The x.y.0 release date, null while unreleased.

planned.description: The planned GA date of an unreleased version, else null.

id.description: PHP_VERSION_ID of x.y.0 (80300 for 8.3), as PHPStan phpVersion takes it.

rector_set.description: The ->withPhpSets() named argument (php83), or null where drupilot assumes none.

docker_cli_image.description: The official php CLI image tag, null while none exists.

ddev_supported.description: Whether DDEV's php_version accepts it (null: unknown).

drupal_core_floor.description: The oldest Drupal core minor that supports this PHP, when certain; null otherwise.
